title: Implesta: sales, planning, time and invoicing in one place
description: One platform for firms that sell their people's time. Each team hears what happens elsewhere that affects their work, from first contact to final payment.
h1: Every team knows what they need to know. Nobody has to chase.
lead: Implesta is one platform for sales, planning, timesheets and invoicing, built for firms that sell their people's time. It tells each person what happens elsewhere that affects their work, the moment it happens.
ctaNote: {minutes} minutes with {founder}, using a scenario like yours. No slides.

stages.name: First contact
stages.happens: A client asks for two engineers for six weeks. Sales logs the request on the client record.

screen.describes: Haverland client record with the Line 3 request

signals.title: New request: Haverland Foods, 480 h
signals.line: Line 3 PLC migration. See who could be free from next Monday.

stages.name: Proposal
stages.happens: Sales and the delivery team build the proposal together: scope, effort and who could do the work. The client reviews it.

screen.describes: Scoping on the Line 3 deal, with its deadline

signals.title: Help scope this proposal by Thursday
signals.line: Client brief and sales notes are attached.

signals.title: Deal likely to close this week: Haverland Foods
signals.line: 480 h from next Monday. Line up people before it is signed.

stages.name: Planning
stages.happens: Operations pencils in people by skills and availability while the deal is still open. Conflicts and over-allocation show up straight away.

screen.describes: Allocation grid with two engineers pencilled in

signals.title: 2 people pencilled in for Haverland Foods
signals.line: Jonas De Smet and Elise Vandamme, from next Monday. Tell the client who could start.

signals.title: Possible assignment from next Monday
signals.line: Line 3 PLC migration, Haverland Foods. Pencilled in, not confirmed.

stages.name: Project
stages.happens: The client signs online. The deal becomes a project with the scope and budget that were sold, and the pencilled-in people are confirmed.

screen.describes: The new project with scope, budget, milestones and team

signals.title: You are confirmed on Line 3 PLC migration
signals.line: 6 weeks, 40 h a week. Client contact: Ann Lievens.

signals.title: Proposal signed: Haverland Foods, €49,200
signals.line: Billing terms and client billing details are filled in.

stages.name: Time
stages.happens: Engineers log hours. Managers approve them, and the client approves from a link.

screen.describes: A project at 460 of 400 budgeted hours

signals.title: Hours over budget: Packaging line commissioning
signals.line: 460 of 400 h. Talk to the client before the next invoice.

stages.name: Invoice
stages.happens: A billing moment is reached. The invoice is prepared from approved hours and goes out through your accounting tool.

screen.describes: An invoice prepared from last month's approved hours

signals.title: Prepare invoice: Packaging line commissioning
signals.line: Last month's approved hours. Lines, rates and client details are filled in.

stages.name: Payment
stages.happens: Payments come back from the accounting tool. The project closes against its budget.

signals.title: Invoice 30 days overdue: Haverland Foods
signals.line: €22,651.20. Mention it before proposing new work.

signals.title: Line 1 safety retrofit closed at 38% margin
signals.line: Target was 40%. See where the hours went.

facts.label: About Implesta
items: For firms of {firmSize} that sell their people's time
Prepares invoices for your accounting tool

pullPush.h2: Silos are not about tools. They are about who finds out, and when.
today: You ask a colleague in another team, and wait
You search a mailbox or open someone else's tool
You find out about the overrun at invoice time
Mostly, you don't know what you don't know
pullPush.withTitle: With Implesta, it comes to you
with: What affects your work reaches you when it happens
It appears where you already work, next to the client or project it concerns
Only what matters to your role, so nothing gets buried
Every team works from the same flow, from first contact to payment

outcomes.h2: What changes when the right people know in time

items.title: Smoother operations
items.text: Operations hears a deal is about to close and lines up people before the contract is signed. Engineers see where they are pencilled in, and when it is confirmed.
items.outcome: People planned on time, fewer surprises

items.title: Smoother sales
items.text: The account manager hears when hours run over budget or an invoice goes overdue, before the next client call.
items.outcome: Renewals at the right moment, no awkward calls

items.title: Faster payment
items.text: A billing moment tells the billing owner to prepare the invoice, with the lines filled in. An overdue invoice reaches the account manager.

margin.h2: And you see margin while the work is running
margin.text: Hours, rates and expenses meet the budget every day. When a project drifts, you know in week three, not at the final invoice.

founder.h2: Built by someone who knows the problem
founder.text: [[Three sentences from Bert: what he saw in services firms, why the existing tools fell short, why he built Implesta.]]

switching.h2: Switching takes {onboardingTime}, and we do the heavy part

items.title: We import your data
items.text: Clients, contacts, open deals, people and rates, from your current tools or spreadsheets.

items.title: Your accounting stays
items.text: Implesta prepares the invoice. Your accounting tool still numbers, sends and books it.

items.title: Your team is shown how
items.text: One training session per role, a short video for team members, and 30 days of support after you go live.

price.h2: {price} per full user, {teamPrice} per team member
price.text: Per month, everything included. Prices exclude VAT.

items.q: Does it work with our accounting tool?
items.a: Implesta prepares the invoice; your accounting tool numbers, sends and books it. Connected today: {accountingTools}. Any other tool works through a manual route: mark the invoice as sent and type its number.

items.q: What happens to our current data?
items.a: We import clients, contacts, open deals, people and rates from our spreadsheet templates, as part of onboarding. Moving history out of another system is quoted separately. Switching takes {onboardingTime}.

items.q: Can my team use it in Dutch or French?
